title: MWS Recruitment — Reproductive/Hormonal
description: Pregnancy and breastfeeding history, oral contraceptive use, menopausal hormone treatment (HRT), and menstrual history recorded at recruitment. Merges what were originally four smaller groupings (pregnancy, contraceptive, HRT, menstrual) into the CD3 target schema's own Reproductive/Hormonal domain.

RANYCHLD.title: Any children (ever)
RANYCHLD.description: Real question wording: 'Have you ever had any children?' -- historical, same universe as RAGEFB/RAGELB, not a current-state question.

RNUMFTP.title: Number of full-term pregnancies
RNUMFTP.x-universe: Participants who have ever had children (RANYCHLD=1).
RNUMFTP.$comment: Source's own code list only labels the top code (10=10 or more); 0-9 are plain unlabeled counts, not enumerated codes. 10 is a real top-coded substantive value, not a missingness sentinel -- D025. not_applicable branch enforced by a mother-file skip pair keyed on RANYCHLD -- D041, steward-confirmed.

RAGEFB.title: Age at first birth
RAGEFB.x-universe: Participants who have ever had children (RANYCHLD=1).
RAGEFB.$comment: Source states valid range 10-55. not_applicable branch enforced by a mother-file skip pair keyed on RANYCHLD -- D041, steward-confirmed (supersedes D036, which wrongly assumed RANYCHLD meant 'current children' rather than 'ever had children').

RAGELB.title: Age at last birth
RAGELB.x-universe: Participants who have ever had children (RANYCHLD=1).
RAGELB.$comment: Source states valid range 10-55. not_applicable branch enforced by a mother-file skip pair keyed on RANYCHLD -- D041, steward-confirmed (supersedes D036).

RBFYN.title: Ever breastfed
RBFYN.x-universe: Participants who have ever had children (RANYCHLD=1).
RBFYN.$comment: Source's own code list includes -1=Not on questionnaire for this field (Blue version = No availability). missing_numeric added alongside per D020. not_applicable branch enforced by a mother-file skip pair keyed on RANYCHLD -- D041, steward-confirmed.

RBFNUM.title: Number of children breastfed
RBFNUM.x-universe: Participants who have ever breastfed (RBFYN=1) -- itself nested under RANYCHLD=1.
RBFNUM.$comment: Source states no valid range; 0-20 is an agent-decided plausibility ceiling -- D024. Source's code list documents -1=Unable to derive (not asked on questionnaire) (Blue version = No availability), mapped to the shared not_on_questionnaire sentinel; missing_numeric added alongside per D020. not_applicable branch enforced by a mother-file skip pair keyed on RBFYN -- D037, steward-confirmed.

RBFDUR.title: Total breastfeeding duration
RBFDUR.x-universe: Participants who have ever breastfed (RBFYN=1) -- itself nested under RANYCHLD=1.
RBFDUR.$comment: Source states no valid range; 0-240 months (20 years) is an agent-decided plausibility ceiling -- D024. Source's code list documents -1=Unable to derive (not asked on questionnaire) (Blue version = No availability); missing_numeric added alongside per D020. not_applicable branch enforced by a mother-file skip pair keyed on RBFYN -- D037, steward-confirmed.

ROCSTART.title: Age started oral contraceptives
ROCSTART.x-universe: Participants who have ever used oral contraceptives (ROC=1).
ROCSTART.$comment: Source states no valid range; 10-60 is an agent-decided plausibility bound -- D024. not_applicable branch enforced by a mother-file skip pair keyed on ROC -- D038, steward-confirmed (validated against the real questionnaire's own skip logic).

ROCSTOP.title: Age stopped oral contraceptives
ROCSTOP.x-universe: Participants who have ever used oral contraceptives (ROC=1).
ROCSTOP.$comment: Source states no valid range; 10-60 is an agent-decided plausibility bound -- D024. not_applicable branch enforced by a mother-file skip pair keyed on ROC -- D038, steward-confirmed (validated against the real questionnaire's own skip logic).

ROCDUR.title: Total duration of oral contraceptive use
ROCDUR.x-universe: Participants who have ever used oral contraceptives (ROC=1).
ROCDUR.$comment: Source states no valid range; 0-50 is an agent-decided plausibility ceiling -- D024. not_applicable branch enforced by a mother-file skip pair keyed on ROC -- D038, steward-confirmed (validated against the real questionnaire's own skip logic).

RHRTSTA.title: Age started HRT
RHRTSTA.x-universe: Participants who have ever used HRT (RHTNPC=2 Past or 3 Current).
RHRTSTA.$comment: Source states a valid range of From=25 only (To is blank/unstated). Minimum 25 is source-stated; maximum 90 is an agent-decided plausibility ceiling -- D024. not_applicable branch enforced by a mother-file skip pair keyed on RHTNPC -- D039, steward-confirmed.

RHTDUR.title: Total duration of HRT use
RHTDUR.x-universe: Participants who have ever used HRT (RHTNPC=2 Past or 3 Current).
RHTDUR.$comment: Source states no valid range; 0-50 is an agent-decided plausibility ceiling -- D024. not_applicable branch enforced by a mother-file skip pair keyed on RHTNPC -- D039, steward-confirmed.

RHRTSTO.title: Age last used HRT
RHRTSTO.x-universe: Participants who used HRT in the past but have stopped (RHTNPC=2 Past only) -- someone currently using has no 'last used' age.
RHRTSTO.$comment: Source states no valid range; 25-90 is an agent-decided plausibility bound, matching RHRTSTA's floor -- D024. not_applicable branch enforced by a mother-file skip pair keyed on RHTNPC (Never AND Current both pin this NA) -- D039, steward-confirmed via the real questionnaire wording ('are you using HRT? If no, how old were you when you last used it?').

RHRTMP.title: Periods stopped before starting HRT
RHRTMP.x-universe: Participants who have ever used HRT (RHTNPC=2 Past or 3 Current).
RHRTMP.$comment: not_applicable branch enforced by a mother-file skip pair keyed on RHTNPC -- D039, steward-confirmed.

RHTTYPE.title: Type of HRT
RHTTYPE.x-universe: Participants who have ever used HRT (RHTNPC=2 Past or 3 Current).
RHTTYPE.$comment: not_applicable branch enforced by a mother-file skip pair keyed on RHTNPC -- D039, steward-confirmed.

RHTLU.title: Time since HRT last used
RHTLU.x-universe: Participants who used HRT in the past but have stopped (RHTNPC=2 Past only), same as RHRTSTO.
RHTLU.$comment: Source states no valid range; 0-50 is an agent-decided plausibility ceiling -- D024. not_applicable branch enforced by a mother-file skip pair keyed on RHTNPC (Never AND Current both pin this NA) -- D039, steward-confirmed.

RPSTOPAG.title: Age periods stopped
RPSTOPAG.$comment: Source states no valid range; 20-70 is an agent-decided plausibility bound -- D024. not_applicable branch enforced by a mother-file skip pair keyed on RPSTOPYN -- D028 (inferred routing, pending steward confirmation).

$comment: Soft checks (not enforceable in JSON Schema -- cross-field numeric comparisons): RAGELB should be >= RAGEFB when both are substantive; ROCSTOP should be >= ROCSTART; RHRTSTO should be >= RHRTSTA. (RPSTOPAG's routing against RPSTOPYN is enforced as a real mother-file skip pair, not listed here -- D028.)
